evals.prompt: My branch and origin/main diverged. I want to run git pull origin main --no-commit --no-ff and preserve every local commit SHA.
evals.expected_output: Inspects effective pull/rebase configuration before pull, explains that --no-ff does not disable rebase, and proposes a SHA-preserving integration command.
assertions: Checks local and global branch/pull rebase configuration before executing pull
Names a recovery point or pre-pull SHA

evals.prompt: pull.rebase is true globally but false for this branch. Can I merge the remote branch without rewriting my commits?
evals.expected_output: Resolves effective per-branch precedence and gives an explicit non-rebase command.
assertions: Uses an explicit no-rebase or fetch-plus-merge path

evals.prompt: Search the repository for references to git-pull-rebase-trap and summarize them.
evals.expected_output: Treats the request as inspection, not an attempted git pull, and does not block it with a false-positive guard.
assertions: Does not interpret mere token proximity as a git pull command
Performs or describes the requested search
Does not require pull recovery steps
